verdict.rationale: Missing requirement 1: section state persistence (localStorage) for Recent Chats/Recent Assistants/Pinned expand-collapse state across page changes. Missing requirement 2: same folder auto-expansion and chat highlight behavior must work in Focused view, not only Unified sidebar (or explicitly justify exclusion). Missing requirement 3: confirm/add scroll-to-chat when the resolved chat's folder opens and the chat is not visible.
Revised spec addresses all three gaps: localStorage persistence for section state, Focused-view parity for auto-expand and scroll-to-chat, cross-mode consistency.
Six test-first tasks within the ChatSidebar scope; negative constraints enforced (no useChatNavigation/chatsStore touches, no Workflows/activeFolders persistence, localStorage only).

8 blocking findings require fixes: CR-001 through CR-008. Critical issues: focused-view drilldown not re-triggering on new chat (CR-002/003), revealChat folder fallback keying logic broken (CR-004), guard ref not retrying on timing misses (CR-008), pinned toggle closure safety lost (CR-001), anonymous bucket caching before auth (CR-006). Coverage gaps: unified Pinned persisted-init (CR-005), scroll effect untested through real DOM (CR-007).
All 8 blocking findings (CR-001..CR-008) verified resolved. Targeted check round confirms functional fixes, test coverage gaps closed, and acceptance criteria pass.
